title: Import and index UEVR public reference repositories
steps: Create the upstream-reference/uevr directory if missing.
Clone each missing repository without modifying upstream content.
For an existing clone, fetch origin without switching away from its pinned research commit automatically.
Record repository URL, current branch, HEAD SHA, fetch timestamp and detected licence files in a manifest.
Generate a file inventory grouped by rendering, OpenXR/OpenVR, camera, UObjectHook, UI, input, plugin API and injection frontend.
Write derived architecture notes under VR-Research-Lab/engine-architecture without copying proprietary game assets.
Keep cloned upstream repositories out of normal Stephanos product builds and test discovery.
acceptance: All three canonical repositories are available locally or a precise blocker is reported.
Every repository is pinned by commit SHA.
Licence and attribution files remain intact.
A manifest and architecture-index report are produced.
No game assets or unclear third-party profile packages are imported.
